nodes.name: MOI Abort to Flyby
nodes.text: Abort Mars Orbit Insertion burn. Reconfigure for flyby trajectory. Requires minimum 100 m/s delta-v reserve. Crew confirmation required.

nodes.name: EDL Abort to Orbit
nodes.text: Abort EDL sequence before atmospheric entry interface. Fire abort motors. Return to Mars orbit. Only valid before atmospheric entry.

nodes.name: Vehicle Safe Mode Entry
nodes.text: Shed all non-essential loads. Point solar arrays at Sun. Maintain minimum attitude control. Await crew assessment or ground command.

nodes.name: RCS Thrusters
nodes.text: Reaction Control System for attitude maintenance

nodes.name: Main Engine
nodes.text: Primary propulsion for orbit insertion and major maneuvers
